source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Bumpers, p.14-8

procedures.title: Front bumper (Corvette): remove and install
steps: Separate the guards from the face bar.
Record where shims and washers go as you strip the assembly, to ease reassembly.
(Installation) Bolt the face bar to the bumper braces loosely.
Fit the guards to the face bar and frame crossmember loosely.
Align the bumper to the body, then tighten the outer face bar bolts first, then the center bolts, and the guard-to-frame bolts last.
Lower the car off the hoist.

procedures.title: Rear bumper (Corvette): remove and install
steps: (Removal) Put the car on a hoist.
From under the car, remove the bolts, washers and nuts fastening the bumper to the braces and rods, outboard bolts first.
Remove the braces and rods from the frame.
(Installation) Attach the braces and rods to the frame loosely.
Fit all bolts, washers and nuts before tightening any of them.
Align the rear bumpers to the body, then tighten all bolts.
notes: Steps cover the left-hand bumper; the right-hand side is done the same way.
See figure 9 in the manual (exploded view of the rear bumper installation, on the previous page).

procedures.title: Rear license plate housing (Corvette): remove
steps: Remove the housing retaining screws and lift the housing off.
